name: Investment Banking
description: Advisory, equity and debt capital markets underwriting, and the deal pipeline.

dimensions.name: product
dimensions.description: M&A advisory, ECM, DCM, leveraged finance

metrics.name: fee_revenue
metrics.description: Investment banking fees recognized in the period

metrics.name: deal_volume
metrics.description: Credited deal value in the period

metrics.name: wallet_share
metrics.description: Firm fees divided by the total industry fee pool

metrics.name: pipeline_value
metrics.description: Expected fees in the pipeline at a point in time

conventions.rule: League-table credit follows the data provider's rules (full vs apportioned credit); state which.
Advisory fees are recognized at completion; announced deals are not revenue.

insight_rules.reason: Market share is a ratio; attribute via firm fees and the fee pool separately.

caveats.text: Fees are lumpy and driven by a few large deals; one quarter's change is rarely a trend.
Pipeline and live-deal data are likely material non-public information; confirm information-barrier clearance before sharing.

chart_conventions.rule: Show the pipeline as a stage funnel or stacked bar by stage; never mix it with recognized revenue on one axis.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
